# Analytics {.mb-3}

This section will present data-driven analyses, decision frameworks, visual explanations, and analytical experiments.

Planned themes include customer-centric systems, e-commerce scalability, measurable operating frameworks, and the relationship between human cognition and decision quality.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false}
**Status Notice:** The analytics archive is currently initializing. Future Quarto documents can be added as standalone pages or computational notebooks.
:::

## Computational Methodology

The analytics repository is engineered to host both reproducible Python/R computational notebooks and interactive HTML widgets:

- **Reproducible Notebooks:** All future analytical papers will feature executable code cells, clear dependency manifests, and data provenance.
- **Parametric Modeling:** Interactive sensitivity simulations allowing readers to test different operational scenarios.
- **Open Synthesis:** Data visualizations and analytical templates will be released directly through this repository under open academic practices.

To collaborate or request a deep-dive on specific framework implementations, visit the [About page](about.qmd) or follow ongoing work on [ResearchGate](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Md-Salauddin-Emon){target="_blank"}.
